description: This file defines the FtlWriter class, responsible for processing FreeMarker Template Language (FTL) templates within the OFBiz framework. It handles rendering RenderableFtl objects and FTL strings, writing the processed output to Appendables, and managing template environments.

classes.name: FtlWriter
classes.description: A utility class that processes FTL templates and writes the results to Appendable objects. It manages template environments and provides methods to process RenderableFtl objects and raw FTL strings, utilizing FreeMarker for rendering.

classes.name: FtlWriter.RenderableFtlFtlWriterVisitor
classes.description: Inner class implementing RenderableFtlVisitor to process different types of RenderableFtl objects and render their contents via FreeMarker templates to an Appendable.

methods.name: FtlWriter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the FtlWriter with a macro library path and a VisualTheme.

methods.name: processFtl
methods.description: Processes a RenderableFtl object by rendering it as a template and writing the output to the provided Appendable.

methods.name: processFtlString
methods.description: Processes an FTL string as a template with a given locale and writes the result to the Appendable.

methods.name: getEnvironment
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a FreeMarker Environment for rendering templates associated with the given Appendable and locale.
